Node.description: Represents an entity or concept in the knowledge graph.

context.description: A short (one sentence, under 200 characters) supporting detail from the text that isn't captured by label/type alone - e.g. a date, number, quote fragment, or key nuance. Use an empty string when there's nothing beyond the bare fact.
context.title: Context

id.description: The unique, standardized identifier for the entity. It MUST be lowercase and use underscores (_) as separators. For numbers like age, it MUST be prefixed (e.g., 'age_34'). MUST NOT be an integer.
id.title: Id

label.description: The human-readable, capitalized name of the entity. If not provided, it will be auto-generated from the id.
label.title: Label

type.description: The general category of the entity, always lowercase. Must be one of: person, organization, location, event, concept, product, technology, date, other.
type.title: Type

Node.title: Node

Relationship.description: A relationship between two nodes in the knowledge graph.

context.description: A short (one sentence, under 200 characters) supporting detail about this specific relationship - e.g. 'since 2019, as VP of Engineering' - when the text provides one. Use an empty string when there's nothing beyond the bare relationship fact.
context.title: Context

id.description: Unique human-readable identifier for the relationship
id.title: Id

type.description: Relationship type: a general, timeless, UPPERCASE verb phrase with underscores (e.g., 'WORKS_AT', 'LOCATED_IN').
type.title: Type

Relationship.title: Relationship

description: A knowledge graph consisting of nodes and relationships.

nodes.description: List of nodes in the knowledge graph
nodes.title: Nodes

relationships.description: List of relationships in the knowledge graph
relationships.title: Relationships

title: KnowledgeGraph
